steps.message:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-32, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 184.7 | 18.51 | 18.51
2 | 735.3 | 0.77 | 19.28
3 | 503.9 | 2.27 | 21.55
4 | 56.6 | 33.69 | 55.24
5 | 43.3 | 5.90 | 61.14
6 | 520.0 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve type of the vertical electrical sounding (VES) station, we examine the resistivities of the layers in depth order:

1.  Layer 1: 184.7 $\Omega \cdot \text{m}$
2.  Layer 2: 735.3 $\Omega \cdot \text{m}$
3.  Layer 3: 503.9 $\Omega \cdot \text{m}$
4.  Layer 4: 56.6 $\Omega \cdot \text{m}$
5.  Layer 5: 43.3 $\Omega \cdot \text{m}$
6.  Layer 6: 520.0 $\Omega \cdot \text{m}$

We group them into consecutive sets of three layers and assign a letter based on the provided notation (A: $r_1 < r_2 < r_3$; Q: $r_1 > r_2 > r_3$; H: $r_1 > r_2 < r_3$; K: $r_1 < r_2 > r_3$):

*   **Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):** 184.7, 735.3, 503.9. 
    $184.7 < 735.3$ and $735.3 > 503.9 \implies r_1 < r_2 > r_3$ (K)
*   **Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):** 735.3, 503.9, 56.6. 
    $735.3 > 503.9$ and $503.9 > 56.6 \implies r_1 > r_2 > r_3$ (Q)
*   **Group 3 (Layers 3-4-5):** 503.9, 56.6, 43.3. 
    $503.9 > 56.6$ and $56.6 > 43.3 \implies r_1 > r_2 > r_3$ (Q)
*   **Group 4 (Layers 4-5-6):** 56.6, 43.3, 520.0. 
    $56.6 > 43.3$ and $43.3 < 520.0 \implies r_1 > r_2 < r_3$ (H)

Combining these letters in depth order gives the sequence: KQQH.

{"curve_type": "KQQH"}
